articles.title: In 1981, two satellites were launched by NASA to study the interactions between Earth's magnetosphere and ionosphere
articles.description: In 1981, two satellites were launched by NASA to study the interactions between Earth's magnetosphere and ionosphere. The Dynamics Explorer mission used two spacecraft, DE-1 and DE-2, to study space plasma, electric currents and energy flow. Both satellites launched together and followed polar orbits. DE-1 operated at higher altitudes, while DE-2 studied the region closer to Earth before re-entering the atmosphere in 1983.

articles.title: Iran Tracking U.S. Troops? Pentagon Shuts Down Digital Trail After Location Data Fears Explode
articles.description: The U.S. military is taking new steps to limit the digital location trail generated by devices used by American personnel, amid growing concerns over the security risks of commercial location data. Advertising identifiers on some military phones and computers have reportedly been disabled, raising fresh questions about whether sensitive troop movements and base locations could be exposed through data brokers. The move comes as U.S. forces face heightened security concerns in the Middle East following attacks linked to Iran. Could smartphone data reveal where American troops are operating? And how vulnerable are military personnel to digital tracking? Here’s what the latest developments reveal about the emerging battle over military location data and operational security.
